title: Blog Bonus Character Creation Tables, 2026 Edition (Freebie)
author: NaldoDrinan
content_html:
Avid blog readers will know that there has been numerous character options added over the 2+ years we've been posting freebies. These help expand your choices when creating a new BREAK!! character, but what if you want to roll everything (or mostly everything) randomly like you can with the default options? This blog post is here to help facilitate that desire. 

These two tables can be used in lieu of their counter parts in the core rules during character creation. There are two important hiccups to remember when using these: if you roll a Purr as your Calling, you are pretty much done - just go to that entry an use it to finish your character. In addition, if you get Unterkin for your Species, you may need to go back and adjust your Calling.
